facts.text: Founded in 1846 by the Sisters of Mercy, Saint Xavier University is Chicago's oldest Catholic university and the first Mercy institution of higher learning in the United States.

sources.quote: Founded in 1846 by the Sisters of Mercy, Saint Xavier University is Chicago's oldest Catholic university and the first Mercy institution of higher learning in the United States.

facts.text: Under the Access Advantage program, eligible incoming Illinois resident students with a family Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) of $80,000 or less receive 100 percent of tuition and mandatory fees for their first year at SXU.

sources.title: SXU Access Advantage - Saint Xavier University
sources.quote: Through the Access Advantage program, eligible incoming students receive 100 percent of tuition and mandatory fees for their first year at SXU through a combination of federal, state and institutional financial aid.

sources.title: SXU Access Advantage - Saint Xavier University
sources.quote: Household Income: Have a family Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) of $80,000 or less.

sources.title: SXU Access Advantage - Saint Xavier University
sources.quote: State Residency: Both you and at least one parent or guardian must be Illinois residents.
